text: Before anyone sees the celebrity, his day has already begun. A call interrupts a quiet morning, and suddenly the schedule is moving.
He grabs a few moments with his coffee, knowing that soon even a simple walk will be watched.
By the time he reaches the event, phones are raised, cameras flash, and a familiar face becomes the center of attention.
He smiles and waves, but the carpet is only one part of the job. Inside the studio, another conversation waits, another chance to tell a story while the lights stay on.
Then, just beyond the barrier, someone catches his eye. He raises a hand, and for a second the distance between them feels smaller.
The cameras keep flashing as he walks away.
Later, back at home, the noise gives way to quiet. Because behind the public image is a person who needs a moment to breathe, too.
